high_level_description: This image captures a serene beach scene during what appears to be either early morning or late evening, as suggested by the soft, diffused light and the dark, cloudy sky. The horizon is clearly visible, separating the calm ocean from the overcast sky. The beach itself is sandy and stretches out towards the water. The waves are gentle, with white foam forming as they break near the shore. There are two individuals visible on the left side of the image, walking along the beach.
